instructions.title: Review Surface Investigation Briefing
instructions.message: Proceed to the Mission Control navigation station.
instructions.guidance: Review the official Sol 3 target and the saved Sol 4 investigation and Sol 5 aerial evidence. Sol 6 uses this target without offering another selection.
instructions.activity: Confirm the briefing after checking the target reference and available prior records.

instructions.title: Prepare Geological Field Equipment
instructions.message: Proceed to the existing Science Lab scientific analysis station.
instructions.guidance: Review the available sample-handling workflow and document equipment or data limitations. No unavailable tool or laboratory capability is assumed.
instructions.activity: Confirm equipment preparation in the existing Science Lab interface.

instructions.title: Prepare for Mars Surface Exploration
instructions.message: Use the existing EVA preparation interaction in the Airlock.
instructions.guidance: Activate the global EVA suit before using the existing Mars terrain entrance. Suit and resource state remain governed by the shared EVA system.
instructions.activity: The task is validated by successful activation of the existing EVA suit.

instructions.title: Reach the Selected Investigation Target
instructions.message: Enter Mars terrain and walk to the target selected during Sol 3.
instructions.guidance: Use the existing target marker and physical terrain navigation. Arrival is validated from the selected target's scene transform; no teleport or autopilot is used.
instructions.activity: Reach the resolved target area on foot; entering terrain alone does not complete this task.

instructions.title: Conduct Ground-Level Geological Observations
instructions.message: At the selected target, record a field observation.
instructions.guidance: Describe only what is available to observe in the scene. Keep interpretation separate and state uncertainty. No fabricated geological measurements or historical results are supplied.
instructions.activity: Save a target-linked observation record before sample collection.

instructions.title: Collect and Secure a Soil Sample
instructions.message: At the field site, register and secure one simulated regolith sample.
instructions.guidance: The sample record receives a unique ID and retains its selected-target provenance. This interaction does not represent drilling, mining, or verified physical sample acquisition.
instructions.activity: Confirm collection after the field observation has been saved.

instructions.title: Return to the Airlock
instructions.message: Manually return to the existing Airlock entrance in Mars Terrain.
instructions.guidance: Use the existing return transition. The active EVA suit and secured sample persist through the configured transition, and entering the Airlock does not remove the suit.
instructions.activity: Interact with the existing return point; no new transition is added.

instructions.title: Complete Airlock Entry and Remove EVA Suit
instructions.message: Inside the Airlock, use the existing EVA preparation interaction to remove the suit.
instructions.guidance: The Central Hub entrance remains blocked while the suit is active. Remove it explicitly at the existing preparation point.
instructions.activity: The task is validated only after the shared EVA state confirms suit removal.

instructions.title: Transfer Sample to the Science Lab
instructions.message: Proceed to the existing Science Lab analysis station.
instructions.guidance: Register receipt of the same secured sample ID and preserve its target and collection provenance.
instructions.activity: Confirm transfer using the saved sample record.

instructions.title: Perform Preliminary Sample Analysis
instructions.message: Use the existing Science Lab analysis station.
instructions.guidance: Record visual description, texture, colour, interpretation, and limitations. Any gameplay-generated observations are identified as simulated; unsupported chemistry and biology remain unavailable.
instructions.activity: Save a target-linked analysis for the same sample ID.

instructions.title: Initiate Soil Cultivation Experiment
instructions.message: Proceed to the existing Science Lab cultivation console.
instructions.guidance: Register the analysed sample in the existing unit. The experiment remains IN PROGRESS; no result is available during Sol 6 and the result is deferred to the Sol 8 mission.
instructions.activity: Persist the sample-linked experiment with the existing unit reference and pending result.

instructions.title: Submit Sol 6 Surface Investigation Report
instructions.message: Submit the completed report at the Mission Control navigation station.
instructions.guidance: Include the official target, prior context, field observations, sample provenance, preliminary analysis, limitations and cultivation status marked pending until Sol 8.
instructions.activity: Submit only after all prior activities and the persisted report evidence validate.

completion.title: Sol 6 Surface Investigation Complete
completion.message: The target-linked field record, secured sample, preliminary analysis and pending cultivation experiment are saved. Sol 7 is not started automatically.
